# @loom/deploy-sim

Deploy-simulation for Loom — replay historical event logs (especially in-flight suspended executions) against new flow definitions to catch resume-breaking changes before promoting

## Entry points

- `@loom/deploy-sim`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
